The objective was to support the African Union's Liaison Offices (AULO:s) on the continent, to be the "ears and eyes" of the AU and report back to PSD and PSC.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: The agreement was valid for support in 2014 and 2015, a total of 30 million SEK were disbursed (half in December 2013, half in December 2014). The programme manager at the time, assessed that the capacity of the liaison offices had been tested during 2015 the beginning of 2016, and had improved their participation in crisis management. Notably, offices in Mali, CAR, Madagascar and Guinea Bissau contributed positively as crises unfolded. Offices in South Sudan and Burundi were stretched to the limits, with high expectations on the AU presence. Regarding the AUC:s programme management, some improvements had been made, with steering committee meetings being held regularly, and improvements in the quality of reporting. However, audits were delayed. Some dialogue issues remained, such as gender balance in staff, levels of staff supported, and how the continuous renewal of offices mandates should be addressed.
